explanation: Matches the negated question at erdosproblems.com/1022: no c_t→∞ such that families of sets of size ≥t, with fewer than c_t|X| members inside each X, have property B. The answer is 'false' (Wood). Restricting to nonempty X avoids the trivial X=∅ failure. Small-t cases do not make it easier to refute or prove, because of the c_t→∞ requirement. Faithful.
